description: This file defines the AttendanceReport class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for generating attendance reports with filtering capabilities, validation, and data retrieval. It includes methods to prepare filter parameters, validate input, provide report headers and filters, and control access permissions.

classes.name: AttendanceReport
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and managing attendance reports, including filter parameter handling, validation, header and filter definitions, data retrieval, and access control within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters based on request inputs, setting employee number, job title, subunit, employment status, and date range filters.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the report's input parameters, including checks for entity existence and logical date range validation.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Provides the header configuration for the attendance report, including column labels, sizes, and cell properties.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter configuration for the report (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches and returns the report data based on the validated and prepared filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to access the report, throwing an exception if access is denied.
